entities.name: Camel Caravan
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: Domesticated camels carrying 200 kg each traveled in caravans of hundreds across the Sahara and Arabian deserts. A camel could go 10 days without water. Caravan cities like Petra and Palmyra grew fabulously wealthy.
